C.I.D. REGISTRY
Wayside Station.
No. I. O. D. 5
30. 9. 29
Date Sept. 25, 1929.
Subject (in full) : Civil summons served on D.S. Bebenin.
Made by. D.S. Bebenin Forwarded by.
Sir,
With reference to the civil summons served on the under-
signed by Det. Supt. Conduit ordering me to appear in Court on the
morning of Sept. 25th., I beg to report that on the 12th. of Nov.
1926 I signed a guarantee for a friend of mine named G. Koppany, who
on the said date borrowed from an Indian money-lender the sum of
$400.00. He failed to pay same, and in the beginning of January
1928 I had received a letter from a Chinese lawyer Dr. Mei to the
effect that unless the above obligation was settled he would press
the matter through the Provisional Court.
I went to see Dr. Mei immediately and arranged to pay
$400.00 by installments, last payment being some time in the
beginning of 1929, after which I received back my guarantee and the
promissory note of my friend. The last payment I made to Dr.
Mok, Dr. Mei's partner, as Mr. Mei was away from Shanghai at that
time. Because of that Dr. Mei forgot to send a petition to
the Provisional Court for the withdrawal of the case, and automatic-
ally it was set for hearing by the Chinese Judge.
I went to Court this morning as was ordered in the
summons and there met Dr. Mei who appologized for the neglect on his
part and made a verbal application to have the case withdrawn.
（左侧手写批注：H. 501 / Enforcement / to Kng / 1/9 / Mks / Len）
Q. C. (G)
gk.
Senior Det. i/c Wayside. T. Lfft A. Dias P.C. 8.8.
V. Bebenin
（底部手写签名）

路边巡捕房。
I. O. D. 5号
1929年9月30日
日期：1929年9月25日。
主题（全称）：向警佐贝别宁（D.S. Bebenin）送达民事传票。
呈报人：警佐贝别宁（D.S. Bebenin） 转呈人：
先生，
关于康杜特（Conduit）警司向我送达、命令我于9月25日上午出庭的民事传票，谨此报告：1926年11月12日，我为我的朋友G. Koppany签署了一份担保书，该人于当日向一名印度放债人借款400.00元。他未能偿还该笔款项，1928年1月初，我收到中国律师梅博士（Dr. Mei）的来信，称除非清偿上述债务，否则他将通过临时法院处理此事。
我立即去见梅博士，并商定分期支付400.00元，最后一期付款在1929年初的某个时间，此后我收回了我的担保书以及我朋友的借据。最后一笔款项是付给梅博士的合伙人莫克博士（Dr. Mok）的，因为当时梅博士不在上海。因此，梅博士忘记向临时法院提交撤诉申请，导致该案由中国法官自动排期审理。
今晨我按传票命令前往法院，在那里见到了梅博士，他就自己的疏忽表示歉意，并口头申请撤销此案。
（左侧手写批注：H. 501 / 执行科 / 致 Kng / 9月1日 / Mks / Len）
Q. C. (G)
gk.
资深侦探，负责路边巡捕房。T. Lfft A. Dias 巡捕 8.8.
V. Bebenin
（底部手写签名）
